english: A button on the wall of this dark chamber.
Press it. It must be useful.
Sure. Pressing random buttons has never ended poorly.
It is probably connected with these strange stairs leading to nothing.
The goblin lets out a single sound, then he just takes a step back.
Oh! Meek knows this. Meek knows this!
Push button - will open secret door!
That how old master always put it. Button equal secret door.
Your goblin companion also gets sucked into the thought, clearly struggling to come up with a single thing that would need the use of an ominous button of this kind.
Yeah. It's like a... goes up and down. You press a button to make it move.
I'm only as smart as the people in my party.
Careful with that <u>ego</u>. You might not fit in that 'helm' of yours otherwise.
Maybe master will come up with answer later.
I'm going to assume it won't spring a trap, or flood this strange, strange chamber.
You do so, putting a fair bit of force on it.
As you do, a groaning sound fills the chamber.
A passage opens, at the end of the stairs.
Logically, this would lead to... the Temple of Urth.
A faint click reaches your ears.
The goblin gives you an uninterested look.
